Cost-of-Living Tracker

Consumer Price Index at a glance — headline and core inflation year-over-year, plus the categories that hit home. Data is embedded (the BLS API blocks browser requests); update it any time by pasting fresh numbers below.

Update the data

CPI updates once a month. Grab the latest index values from bls.gov/cpi (series CUUR0000SA0 for headline, CUUR0000SA0L1E for core) and paste rows here — any mix of 2026 M06 336.8, 2026-06,336.8, or a copied BLS table works. Values are stored on this machine only and merged with the embedded series.

Optional: if you run a small CORS relay (there's a ready-made template in the suite's relay/worker.js), set its base URL and this tool will fetch the live BLS v1 series through it. The relay receives <base>?url=<encoded target> and returns the raw JSON.

Data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics · Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, not seasonally adjusted).
